scope: Runtime and causal-state admission only; no new semantic/identity accuracy claim
dependency: PuLP3.3.0 pure-Python source at the official tag, needed by native imports. Integer solvers and semi-online consensus are never invoked.
selection: Same first32 scene-0218 camera images and cached current YOLO outputs as the SAM2 audit; every current detection is supplied. No GT or new holdout.
rationale: Use native online external-detection integration. Pixel correspondence is shared among object groups, unlike repeated object-conditioned global attention. Runtime is measured; no speed claim inferred from this structure.
controls: Fresh current-only and persistent past-only core share current image features, detector masks and native merge/output code. Strong identity comparator remains full-rate BoT-SORT, not the fresh-ID control. This probe does not score either.
settings: Native model/default memory capacities and 480 min-side. All objects batched (official default). Every frame incorporates its current detection and writes memory; no cadence reduction. FP16 autocast without compilation. Image normalization and bilinear resizing run on GPU; labels use nearest resizing.
timing: Full adapter call minus paired current-control call, including input preprocessing, shared encoding, native temporal propagation/merge/write and resized output. Initial pass and three reset repeats separately reported. First frame separately, frames1..31 form p95. Excludes YOLO, PTv3, image-file I/O and ROS.
if_failed: Stop this fixed native DEVA configuration. No resolution/memory/detection-cadence sweep or full accuracy launch on failed runtime evidence.
if_passed: Allows bounded same-forward semantic and instance evaluation. Class and mask changes are not accuracy evidence. Long-running metadata bounds and real message-chain latency still need separate work.
